channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "First time SCP: revealing the truth?" - An anomalous laptop that can show secret information through the form of QR codes

item.title: Unofficial Criticism
item.content:encoded:
First time giving an uncertified critique so sorry if it's not more in-depth or complex.

It sounds a little too vague from just the QRcode aspect of it. Who did the laptop originally belong to? What type of classified information are we talking about? Right to the point of Procedure 100-Montauk or a subtle build-up of growing horror with each classified one? What GoI did you have in mind for crafting the aspect of including the other GoI?

item.title: First time SCP: revealing the truth?
item.content:encoded:
An anomalous laptop that can show secret information through the form of QR codes. Basic overview but full sandbox is available if you want.

Seeking green lights: Yes
Type: SCP article
Elevator pitch: On the basic level, this SCP is a computer (laptop) that once a day shows off a QR code. This QR code can show a variety of things, from information about the foundation or other GoIs. This can include classified documents, personnel lists and other related things. It can also be affected by external stimulus through a HDMI port

Central narrative: The SCP starts off in a GoIs hands but is then retrieved by a member MTF Delta 5. It then continues to release more and more classified information and is eventually banned unless permission from 05 council is given.

Hook: The SCP releases information that is unknown before and can lead to either good or bad circumstances such as deaths or a new method for containment of SCPs

Additional notes: None
